infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nova listens to your voice so you can log expenses and ask questions hands-free.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Nova uses on-device speech recognition to turn what you say into text.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nova uses the camera to scan receipts so it can prefill an expense for you to confirm.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nova reads a receipt photo you pick so it can prefill an expense for you to confirm.
